name: figecho
title_zh: 从一张架构图里抽出整套配色版式，再画十张都不走样
tagline_zh: 盯着一张参考图发愁「怎么让新图长得像它」？它能拆出配色、线宽、圆角、字体层级，存成 Style Pack。
tagline_en: Stop redrawing from scratch to match a reference. It extracts colors, strokes, radii, type hierarchy into a Style.
desc_en: Extract reusable visual systems from reference technical diagrams, architecture diagrams, scientific schematics, roadmaps, workflows, frameworks, and technical infographics. Create complete modular prompts, generate style-consistent PNG figures from new content, and save, search, name, validate, or reuse Style Packs with their original reference images. Use for 参考图风格抽取、技术图视觉语法、同风格技术图、技术路线图、架构图、科研示
why_zh: 不是滤镜套壳，而是把视觉语法拆成可复用的模块化 prompt——存包、命名、校验、检索。
why_en: Not a filter overlay. It parses visual grammar into modular prompts, saves named, validated Style Packs with source images, and.
limit_zh: 只认技术类图：架构图、路线图、流程图、科研示意。照片、插画、UI 稿不在射程内；产物是 PNG。
limit_en: Only technical diagrams: architecture, roadmap, workflow, scientific. No photos, illustrations, or UI mockups. Outputs PNG only—no SVG/PPT/editable.
title_en: Extract a full visual system from one diagram, then redraw.
